Palette

class Palette(name, description, finish, grass, rumble, road)[source]

Bases: object

One color palette of the track.

Attributes:
namestr

Name shown on the edit screen (translation source text).

descriptionstr

What the palette is for (tooltip on the edit screen).

finishdict[str, RGB]

{"dark": (r, g, b), "light": (r, g, b)} colors of the finish line.

grassdict[str, RGB]

Dark and light colors of the grass.

rumbledict[str, RGB]

Dark and light colors of the side strip.

roaddict[str, RGB]

Dark and light colors of the road.

Notes

name and description hold the pt_BR source text marked with QT_TRANSLATE_NOOP (context “PlayerKarteaConfigEditView”) for pyside6-lupdate; the edit screen translates them at display time with self.tr() (i18n).
